Nile Birds

Shoebill, a private video player, and Hudhud, a private keyboard. Open source, no ads, no tracking. Same signed APKs as the GitHub releases.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://altyb.github.io/fdroid/repo
